implementation.raw_source_policy: copy-and-retain; derived models never rewrite upstream JSON

invariants: Every fact and relation carries evidence_refs and unresolved references remain non-confirmed.
Boundary status is one of PROPOSED, CONFIRMED, AMBIGUOUS, REJECTED and confidence is bounded to [0, 1].
A body/annex relation is confirmed only by resolvable evidence or an explicit reviewer decision.
Generation is pinned to input_snapshot_id, segmentation_version, and state_version.
Annotation edits do not stale evidence; boundary, fact, and relation edits stale derived generations.
User context is retained outside evidence-bearing objects.

compatibility.legacy_output: unchanged; canonical model is read-only internal projection
